ref: ADR-0006 "Target fields": the queue of each mapped target field is evaluated lazily on first read, so a field never created is never evaluated; min is checked before the first occurrence is written
note: Row (1..2) per Memo/Text in context Orders: the Order has no Memo, so Row creates no occurrence and the run raises po:MINOCCURS at T1 before it writes one. Val under Row comes later in target document order; its queue, sortByKey over two Skus and one Qty in the Order, would raise po:SORTBYKEY at K1 if it were evaluated first.
